findings.summary: Download-mode toggle is rendered as an anchor acting as a button.
findings.consequence: The control currently recreates native button behavior manually with role, tabindex, and key handlers; future disabled/state handling or form semantics can drift from the intended button interaction even though keyboard activation is currently covered.
findings.evidence: Line 251 starts an `<a>` element with no `href`, while lines 253-257 add `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, and Enter/Space handlers to emulate a native button for `toggle-download-mode`.
findings.recommendation: Use `<button type="button" data-library-download-mode>` with the existing classes/content and `@click="emit('toggle-download-mode')"`; remove the manual role/tabindex/key handlers.
verification: Checked direct page usage in app/pages/bibliotek.vue lines 1971-1978 and the state/event paths for download mode.
Checked related dependency components ChronologyRangeSlider.vue and SearchMultiSelect.vue for emitted events and accessibility boundaries.

Read relevant coverage in test/e2e/library-advanced.behavior.spec.ts, test/e2e/library-multiselect-parity.behavior.spec.ts, test/unit/search-multi-select.spec.ts, and test/unit/library-component-boundaries.spec.ts.
